notes.title: Big Demo Update! v0.1.2 is Live 🎯
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a major update to the Greedy Darts demo — v0.1.2 is now live!

Here’s what’s new:

 🧭 Revamped UI for a cleaner, more intuitive experience
 🃏 The total number of cards has increased to 63, opening up more strategy options
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206218/56873d92d71c15c2e2d1aa5aac8018eaf49e5711.png
 📘 Tutorial added — learn the basics quickly and jump right in
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206218/0ee6a6f370ab230fcd38ea12f8eafc8fca7fb71b.png
 🎯 A new game mode: Count Up Only has been added for focused play{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206218/61f8d459a62ea8fdb7a168b87b02be6dc10dfbf3.png
 ✨ Tons of smaller updates including UI tweaks, new effects, and visual polish

This is one of the biggest updates yet, and we’d love to hear what you think!

Please share your feedback with us on [Discord] or in the Steam Community — it really helps shape the game as we move toward Early Access.

👉 Join our Discord

Thanks for playing, and enjoy the new demo!

— tamtam

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First of all, thank you so much to everyone who played the demo and added Greedy Darts to your wishlist 🎯 Your support means the world to us!

We’re happy to report that development is going smoothly — no major issues so far, and we’re making steady progress every week 💪

If you’re interested in more frequent updates, we post development progress regularly on Discord. Feel free to stop by and see what’s going on!

We’re also planning to release a new and improved demo before the Early Access launch. This update will include:

 💡 Reworked and optimized UI
 📚 A new tutorial to help players get started
 🃏 More cards and combos
 🎯 A new game mode: _Just Count Up_ (focused darts scoring)

    
We’re putting a lot into it, and we hope it gives you a better feel for what Greedy Darts is all about.

🗺️ We’ve also shared our development roadmap on Discord, so if you’d like to see what’s coming next, join us!

And of course, we’d love to hear your feedback or ideas — either in the Steam Community discussions or on our Discord.

👉 Discord Community

Thanks again, and talk soon!

tamtam
